scope: Sequential synthetic in-process API journeys; two warm samples per format, one initial sample and one database queue job. No p95, concurrency or production-capacity claim.
method: Same fixtures and application code, fresh PHP processes, source and destination measured sequentially with no other test suite running. OS caches were not cleared. Stage times are inclusive.
queue_wait_note: One sample; database available_at has one-second precision. Do not infer a queue-latency gain from this comparison.

validation.postgres_worker: queue:work --once on an empty dedicated validation queue; default pending jobs preserved
validation.runtime_changes: None. Test-only fixes allow full asynchronous batch completion and use a separately reconciled synthetic E2E fixture.
